title: Mileage Rate Setup
summary: Expense Agent now supports mileage rate configuration through new tables for vehicle types and mileage rates, with corresponding pages and APIs for managing these setup elements.
key_points: New table structures for vehicle types and mileage rates in the Expense Agent
API pages added for programmatic access to vehicle types and mileage rate setup
Existing expense-related pages and tables enhanced with mileage-related fields
Permission sets updated to include access to new mileage rate objects
Auto-population and validation logic extended to handle mileage data
